agent_output.sql: WITH observations AS (SELECT interval_end, SUM(lot_completions) AS lot_completions, MIN(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (interval_end - interval_start)) / 60.0) AS observation_minutes_min, MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (interval_end - interval_start)) / 60.0) AS observation_minutes_max FROM fab13.live_process_snapshots_fab13 WHERE fab_id = 'fab13' AND interval_end >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-10 00:00:00+09:00' AND interval_end < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-13 00:00:00+09:00' GROUP BY interval_end) SELECT '2026-09-10 이상 2026-09-13 미만' AS period_label, AVG(lot_completions) AS lot_completions, COUNT(*) AS observation_count, MIN(interval_end) AS first_observed_at, MAX(interval_end) AS last_observed_at, MIN(observation_minutes_min) AS observation_minutes_min, MAX(observation_minutes_max) AS observation_minutes_max FROM observations ORDER BY period_label
